description: Read a stored result (handle) without running anything: view=summary for its type, size, est_tokens and suggested next ops; view=value for the data itself one page at a time (follow next_offset); view=provenance for the ops, args and source URLs that produced it. Use this when a result came back as a preview and you need more of it. Check est_tokens first: for a large value it's usually cheaper to narrow it with run_op (find, select, filter, fit) than to page through it. Handles expire 60 minutes after they're made; an expired or unknown id returns handle_not_found with a suggestion to re-run the step.

handle.description: A handle id like h_3f9a1c2b7e, from any earlier result.

limit.description: value: page size. Default 4000 characters or 50 items.

offset.description: value: where to start, in characters for text or items for lists. Use next_offset from the previous page.

name: read_handle

chain.description: provenance: ops, args, inputs and sources, oldest first.

next_offset.description: value: offset of the next page; null at the end.

value.description: summary: the value if small. value: this page of it.
